name: claude-migration-skills
description: Web migration/modernization skill pack for Dockerized, Makefile-driven projects. lando-to-docker sets up the upstream Docker Compose + Makefile dev environment (Traefik, PHP-FPM/Apache, MariaDB, Redis) that the other skills require. The Drupal 10 → 11 upgrade is orchestrated by the d11 skill, which delegates to three sub-skills that are also usable standalone: php-docker-upgrade (PHP 8.4/8.5+ bump in Docker), php-deprecations-audit (upgrade_status/rector/phpstan) and jquery-4-migration (jQuery 3 → 4). Plus the Gulp → Vite front build migration (gulp-to-vite), SCSS modernization with sass-migrator (sass-migrator), and a PHP_CodeSniffer + PHPStan campaign orchestrated by php-standards, which sets up the tooling and routes to three passes run one conversation each — phpcbf, phpcs, phpstan — bringing custom code to zero violations, recording the manual UAT for every behaviour-changing fix, and optionally adding the phpcs/phpstan GitLab CI jobs with SonarQube reports. Per-step Git workflow (one Draft MR per step).
